summary.headline: Outcomes of the Astrological Lots
summary.text: Astrological delineations for the lots of the daimon, injury, fortune, children, father, and marriage, including effects of the Sun, Zeus, Kronos, Ares, Hermes, Moon, benefics, malefics, house-masters, beams, signs, and angular positions. A scholion in Paul of Alexandria notes additional lots outside the Panaretos, while marginal notes record variants from Codex r and other readings.
